messages:
lia_csm: Heads up — Solaris Payments asked for a temporary QPS bump and IP allowlist for their dev sandbox in eu-west-1. Partner demo tomorrow 12:00 CET. They expect ~600 QPS for a ~3h window and want it live ahead of the demo. Renewal flagged as high-urgency if this fails.
kevin_net: Can you get exact CIDR ranges? I need them to open the peering rules.
lia_csm: They sent two ranges: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/25. Also requesting a soft route rate increase on /v1/generate from 200 -> 600 QPS for project `solaris-dev`.
ash_ops: We can do a temp allowlist + rate override. Need an agreed revoke time and an ops owner. Proposed revoke: 2026-03-27T14:00:00Z (UTC). OK?
kevin_net: Peering looks fine from infra side. I'll apply network ACLs. Do they expect any special headers or proxies?
lia_csm: They said it's direct from their sandbox IPs, no extra headers. Also asked for request logs to be retained for 7 days for debugging.
nash_ops: Filing infra ticket and preparing the change. Draft config below: 
```
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.128/25
route: /v1/generate
rate_limit_override: 600
window: 3h
revoke_at: 2026-03-27T14:00:00Z
log_retention_days: 7
notes: temporary onboarding/demo exemption
```
sophie_rev: FYI billing — if this stays only for the demo window, mark it as a promo/onboarding exemption so we don't auto-bill excess usage.
lia_csm: Please tag billing note `onboarding-demo-exempt`. Also adding a risk note: if the demo has throttling issues the renewal conversation becomes urgent.
deploy-bot: Scheduled change created: infra/tickets/CS-5421. Change window: 2026-03-27T11:00:00Z -> 2026-03-27T14:00:00Z. Owners: @ash_ops @kevin_net.
nash_ops: :thumbsup: I'll deploy at 11:00Z and monitor. Need someone to own canary traffic and SLA dashboard during the window.
kevin_net: I'll route 10% canary for first 10 minutes and watch latency + 5xx. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/solaris-demo (will add alert thresholds).
lia_csm: Solaris confirmed via email and will be on the demo call. Thanks all — I'll join at 12:00 CET to support.
nash_ops: After change, validate auto-revoke works. If TTL doesn't clear, we'll manually revoke and escalate.
kevin_net: I'll post a short postmortem note in the ticket after the demo with metrics and any anomalies.
lia_csm: Great — closing the loop here.
